# Getting help

- **How it fits together:** [cyber-civitas.github.io](https://cyber-civitas.github.io)
  covers the architecture, the vocabulary, and each component's status.
- **Questions and ideas:** ask in the [Discord #general channel](https://discord.gg/RwzcFpN5fv).
- **Bugs and feature requests:** open an issue in the repository concerned.
- **Security issues:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Do not open a
  public issue.
